title: Prime Power Case: Problem Setup and Definitions
content: Module header documents the prime power specialization of the cyclic vector theorem: when minpoly(M) = p^e for irreducible p, prove M has a cyclic vector without any axioms. The definitions IsCyclicVector and IsNonderogatory (lines 50-55) match the parent files WIP01 and WIP02. Together with WIP02 (squarefree case), this covers the two structural cases of the general theorem.
mathContext: For nonderogatory $M$ with $\text{minpoly}(M) = p^e$ ($p$ irreducible, $e \geq 1$): find $v$ with $\{v, Mv, \ldots, M^{n-1}v\}$ spanning $K^n$. Axiom-free proof by induction on $e$.

title: Utility Lemmas: Irreducible Divisibility and Matrix Non-Vanishing
content: Three utility lemmas. irreducible_dvd_of_annihilated (line 62): If p is irreducible, v != 0, p(M)v = 0, and r(M)v = 0, then p | r. Proof by Bezout: if p does not divide r, then gcd(p,r) = 1 (since p is prime), giving ap + br = 1. Evaluating at M and applying to v: v = 0, contradiction. exists_mulVec_ne_zero (line 84): A nonzero matrix has a vector outside its kernel. aeval_ne_zero_of_lt_minpoly (line 95): If deg(p) < deg(minpoly(M)) and p != 0, then p(M) != 0.
mathContext: Key: $p$ irreducible, $p(M)v = 0$, $r(M)v = 0$, $v \neq 0 \Rightarrow p \mid r$. Via Bezout: $ap + br = 1$, evaluate at $M$: $v = a(M) \cdot 0 + b(M) \cdot 0 = 0$.

title: Core Lemma: Prime Power Divisibility by Induction on e
content: pow_irred_dvd_of_annihilated (line 114) is the mathematical heart: if p is irreducible, p^e(M)v != 0, p^(e+1)(M)v = 0, and r(M)v = 0, then p^(e+1) | r. Proved by strong induction on e. Base (e=0): irreducible_dvd_of_annihilated. Step: w = p^(e+1)(M)v != 0, p(M)w = 0, r(M)w = 0 gives p | r. Write r = p*r1. Let u = p(M)v. IH on u gives p^(e+1) | r1, so p^(e+2) | r. This elementary divisibility argument replaces the PID structure theorem.
mathContext: Induction on $e$: two intermediaries $w = p^{e+1}(M)v$ (for $p \mid r$) and $u = p(M)v$ (for IH). Polynomial commutativity $r(M) \cdot p^k(M) = p^k(M) \cdot r(M)$ is essential.

title: Main Theorem: Cyclic Vector for Prime Power Nonderogatory Matrices
content: nonderogatory_pw_has_cyclic_vector (line 189): For nonderogatory M with minpoly = p^e (p monic irreducible, e >= 1), there exists a cyclic vector. Pick v with p^(e-1)(M)v != 0 (since p^(e-1)(M) != 0 by minimality of minpoly). Then p^e(M)v = 0 (minpoly kills all vectors). For any r with r(M)v = 0 and deg(r) < n: p^e | r by the core lemma, so n = deg(p^e) <= deg(r) < n — contradiction, hence r = 0. Works over any field K (no cardinality assumptions).
mathContext: Degree contradiction: $r(M)v = 0$, $r \neq 0 \Rightarrow p^e \mid r \Rightarrow n = \deg(p^e) \leq \deg(r) < n$. Impossible.
